notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
On Tilt Interactive is announcing our first update to Justice: Fallen Clan with version 1.0.1!

- Now with Oculus Support!

- Added Options Menu - Toggle Shuriken Auto Aim and Controller Touch to Walk

- Minor Bug Fixes and Optimization

notes.title: On Tilt Interactive Community Server
notes.notes:
Hi Tilters, we have created a Discord server, we want to see people giving feedback on our games, discussing VR and catching up on VR news and having a bit of fun with developers. If your interested jump in and have a chat with us!

https://discord.gg/Gnpuczq

notes.title: Update build 0.4
notes.notes:
Hi guys, we are releasing a rather large update tomorrow for the Justice Demo. These changes will cover the following:

Fixes to the lighting for improved vision
Fixes to UI
Main menu
In game data pad
We added a tutorial
Changes to the outdoor level
Reductions to enemy sight radius
Added a death and victory scene
Fixes to sound

Jump in and give it a test for us!
